subject: FLIGHT RESTRICTIONS.
text:
A4161/26 NOTAMR A2090/26
Q) LRBB/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/4501N02531E234
A) LRBB B) 2607270658 C) 2610272359EST
E) FLIGHT RESTRICTIONS.
   UKRAINIAN CRISIS - ALL RUSSIAN REGISTERED AIRCRAFT AND AIRCRAFT
   OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS FROM 
   THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR BY OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR 
   CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES
   ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY ROMANIAN AIRSPACE 
   EXCEPT HUMANITARIAN, SAR AND LEASED AIRCRAFT ONE-WAY RETURN 
   FLIGHTS WITH THE PERMISSION OF THE APPROPRIATE ROMANIAN 
   AUTHORITIES AND IN CASE OF EMERGENCY LANDING OR EMERGENCY 
   OVERFLIGHT.
